'''Osh Scal''' was a [[Kallidahin]] who worked for the [[Archaeological Research Council]] as a [[technician]] on a [[Polis Massa Base|dig site]] in the [[Polis Massa]] [[Asteroid field|asteroid belt]]. When the pregnant [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] was brought to the site with heavy injuries at the end of the [[Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY]], Scal was part of the team that aided her in giving [[Reproduction|birth]] to the [[twin]]s [[Luke Skywalker|Luke]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]] before she [[Death|perished]].

==Biography==
Osh Scal was a [[Kallidahin]] [[technician]]<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> who worked for the [[Archaeological Research Council]]<ref name="USW" /> at an [[Archaeologist|archaeological]] [[Polis Massa Base|dig site]] on an [[asteroid]] in the [[Polis Massa]] [[asteroid field]]. The Kallidahins at the dig site were searching for answers as to why the [[planet]] of Polis Massa had been destroyed and for traces of the extinct [[Eellayin]] [[species]], whom they believed to be their ancestors.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />

In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> at the end of the [[Clone Wars]], [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] and the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda]] brought the injured and heavily pregnant Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] to the dig site so that she could give [[Reproduction|birth]] to the [[twin]]s she was carrying.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Scal was part of a team consisting of two trained [[Doctor|physicians]] and several [[xenobiologist]]s who attended to Amidala, but as her condition was judged to be extremely critical, the group did not even have [[time]] to change out of their [[Clothing|caving jumpsuits]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />

Amidala was placed in a medical facility designed for treating investigators rather than childbirth,<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> and while she lay in labor,<ref name="ROTS" /> Scal and fellow technician [[Dznori Xam]]<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> stood at a nearby monitor studying and gesturing at the readout. During the actual birth, the room was emptied, apart from Kenobi, a [[GH-7 series medical assistance droid|GH-7 medical droid]], and a [[midwife droid]]. The twins survived the birth, but Amidala [[Death|did not]], having lost the will to live following the betrayal of her [[Marriage|husband]], [[Anakin Skywalker]]. She survived only long enough to name the children [[Luke Skywalker|Luke]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Osh_Scal_and_Dznori_Xam.png|thumb|right|300px|Osh Scal and Dznori Xam attended to Padmé Amidala in their caving jumpsuits as she prepared to give birth.]]
Osh Scal and the other Kallidahin technicians at Polis Massa had had little contact with [[human]]s and so did not know much about their parturition. They showed discretion and asked few questions of those accompanying the pregnant Padmé Amidala, although they were baffled when they could not save her life. The Kallidahin had [[Color|purple]]-and-white skin and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />

==Equipment==
Scal wore a blue-and-brown, form-fitting caving jumpsuit with warming lines on the [[Limb|legs]]. It also included [[Limb|leg]] warmers, a [[utility belt]], a voice-activated [[comlink]], and a shoulder-mounted [[Droid caller|droid summoner]] and shoulder [[lamp]]. The technician also wore a wrist-mounted [[tissue analyzer]] and a head-mounted signal light.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />

==Behind the scenes==
Osh Scal first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Years">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character's name was revealed in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> This name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[James Luceno]]<ref name="ROTS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and released on [[April 2]], 2005.<ref name="Amazon">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}}</ref>
